items.source: Adds all events contained in the given aggregate to the current one.
items.translation: 将给定聚合中的所有事件添加到当前事件中。

items.source: All domain events currently captured by the aggregate.
items.translation: 聚合当前捕获的所有领域事件。

items.source: Registers the given event object for publication on a call to a Spring Data repository's save or delete methods.
items.translation: 将给定的事件对象注册，以便在调用 Spring Data 存储库的保存或删除方法时进行发布。

items.source: Convenience base class for aggregate roots that exposes a registerEvent(Object) to capture domain events and expose them via domainEvents(). The implementation is using the general event publication mechanism implied by DomainEvents and AfterDomainEventPublication. If in doubt or need to customize anything here, rather build your own base class and use the annotations directly.
items.translation: 这是一个用于聚合根的便捷基类，它提供 registerEvent(Object) 方法来捕获领域事件，并通过 domainEvents() 方法暴露这些事件。该实现使用了由 DomainEvents 和 AfterDomainEventPublication 所暗示的通用事件发布机制。如果对此有任何疑问或需要自定义任何内容，建议自行构建基类并直接使用这些注解。

items.source: Adds the given event to the aggregate for later publication when calling a Spring Data repository's save or delete method. Does the same as registerEvent(Object) but returns the aggregate instead of the event.
items.translation: 将给定的事件添加到聚合中，以便在调用 Spring Data 存储库的save或delete方法时稍后发布。此方法与registerEvent(Object)功能相同，但返回的是聚合而非事件。

items.source: Clears all domain events currently held.
items.translation: 清除当前持有的所有领域事件。
